findings.title: we #1 loses viability to a delivery livelock in the entrance throat
findings.where: src/sim/ants/behaviours/outdoor/phaseNest.ts updateDeliver (toChamber step); nest field leg at entrance 5483 of we #1's hand-over
findings.detail: we #1 was viable in sweep 12 and is not viable now (starvation stage 2.25 gd, P intake 0.03, 21 workers against 25). Its workers spend 28.6 % of their time in forage.deliver/tend.deliver; the other runs spend 1.3-5.4 %. From day 2 to day 11, 2-8 foragers with full crops sit at (3432.09, 5.32, 1199.02) BU, 2 BU from the open entrance. Their nav is failed/leg on nest:4936:chamber:5664, and updateDeliver re-requests the same leg forever; DELIVER_MAX_S restarts the phase where they stand. Trace of ant 7725 (probe-trace-we1-7725.txt): she enters from the 1199 side, follows the chamber field 0.85 BU down the throat, and the leg fails. On the same hand-over the old mound mask still averages 3.0 stuck deliverers, round 13's pointField 0.13 (one A/B only), and sweep 12's hand-over on this tree 0. So the trap comes from the founding geometry together with a deliver step that has no recovery, not from a proven round-14 change. Repro cache: test-output/viab/cache/founded-lasius-niger-woodland-edge-1-naturalist-d-98af5b84.bin.

findings.title: Buried waste counts toward chamber hygiene but no hauler can reach it (pre-existing; kd #3's dirty royal chamber)
findings.detail: On kd #3's year-two cache with this tree, its royal chamber counts 9 waste items against a tolerance of 3 for 12 gd (probe-buried-kd3.txt). All 9 are spoiled-food lying 0.32-0.35 BU inside the floor (onSurface false, haul priority 0), and new ones keep arriving. Cause: spawnSpoiledItem places the item at centre.y - radii.y, but in real nests the registry's radii.y (1.0-1.5 BU) is larger than the cavity's half-height (1.8-2.1 BU floor to ceiling). The census counts every waste item, reachable or not, and wasteFall leaves items inside solid alone. This contradicts the round's claim that kd #3 is 'most likely the same' hanging-waste case. In the year-two long run, kd #3 lost 6 of its 15 brood to hygiene. A new test is red and left in place: src/sim/colony/wasteFall.verify.test.ts case 2.
